metadata.name: Ocean acidification experiment on Magallana hongkongensis: carbonate chemistry and shell properties
metadata.description: Laboratory dataset containing 27 unique treatment conditions for the oyster Magallana hongkongensis, measuring comprehensive carbonate chemistry parameters (pH, pCO2, DIC, alkalinity, saturation states) and a subset of shell physical properties (porosity, stiffness, hardness, density, volume). All samples collected from Zhanjiang, South China Sea on 2016-06-01. Some treatments produce aragonite undersaturation (Omega Arg < 1), relevant for ocean acidification impact studies.
